style_prompt: Original 2D cartoon style 'SOI DNA': clean flat cel look, bold dark-indigo (#23203A) outlines of even thickness, flat colours with at most one soft shadow tone, warm restrained palette of coral, teal, mustard and cream, oversized bean-shaped heads (head about 40% of body height), small black dot eyes with one white highlight, thick expressive eyebrows, small rosy cheeks, simple 4-finger hands, clear silhouettes. No text, no logo, no watermark.
